reviews.comment: I really enjoyed my class with Professor Collins, he is a very sweet man and you can tell her cares a lot about what he's teaching. I took him for my senior seminar and considering that was the course I didn't find it overly hard. There is a lot of reading but it isn't difficult or boring novels. I would highly recommend everyone take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm surprised Dr. Collins' rating isn't higher. He's a very easy teacher and he gives great feedback on assignments. There is a lot of reading, but if you don't read the material you're not necessarily "behind." There are not many assignments in this course besides reading and a few essays based on the reading. Participation is encouraged.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tough class b/c of grading. We had 5 assignments, one of which was an averaged grade between a rough draft and final draft. Grading took a long time and did not make sense; not a lot of guidance on what was expected of papers other than a page number and an open-ended prompt. Attendance was not required, but it's important to be there.

On the first quiz I didn't know the answers had to be super detailed because the instructions said to write a maximum of 3 sentences. I could have gotten an A if it wasn't for that one low grade. Make sure to write detailed answers. Pay attention to the lectures and read the books. Not an easy A, but an A is definitely achievable!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall, it was a fine class. He graded quizzes and paper extremely tough, and at times I couldn't see the reasoning.

He seems like a very nice guy but it sucks that attendance is mandatory. I'm only taking this class bc it's required and I do good on the assignments only because I'm already really good at writing/english. I get that it's an English class but attendance shouldn't be mandatory in an upper-level class. It also sucked having to hunt down the books.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Collins clearly loves what he teaches about, but he relies a lot on student participation to drive lectures. His grading criteria seems to be completely subjective (which was kind of fair since this was a poetry class). He doesn't give clear instructions on projects until asked for them a few days before they're due. Gives some good feedback

Be ready to read. Submitted our participation via email and he called on students to read them out loud during class. Very difficult grader. I agree with the other reviews that he does not understand how others think. Not very engaging which made it difficult to participate. Reading isn't that bad but there is a lot. Won't bump up an 89.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Collins is a nice guy but what everyone writes on here is accurate. The three quizzes and essay were the most disappointing parts of this class. It's his answer or no answer. What makes it worse is that he gives little to no feedback. He arrives late to class often and is very disorganized.

Dr. Collins was a wonderful instructor who is passionate about the subjects which he teaches. He loves feed-back and classroom discussion, so speak up from time-to-time (he really notices). His grading always seemed very generous and he was always available for further explanation of his grading criteria. Overall, a pleasant guy to learn from.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He passes around an attendance sheet and randomly calls on you in the middle of class. There are 3 quizzes and 2 major essays with a final essay. The grading doesn't make a lot of sense... so you might as well drink some wine and write whatever you want.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I agree with every negative review of Professor Collins. Reading quizzes are graded ludicrously and essays are graded on a whim. Received a 20 point deduction on a paper for not mentioning one detail from the book despite his positive feedback throughout my entire paper. I've never been worried about passing an English course until this one.

I'm only half-way through this semester with Collins and I figured now's a better time to write this. This is not the course you should take if you are taking anything else. It's his class, his time, 24/7. At that, he isn't engaging. Grading criteria is murky. It tends to feel like there is only one right answer--his.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Late to class and very unorganized. His paper grading often made no sense. For example I put the same amount of minimal effort into three short essays (1-2 hours each). I got an 89, 78, and 95, respectively. Really never knew what to expect. He did not lead good discussions or ask engaging questions. He was kind though, I'll give him that.

Is not clear on what he wants and does not understand why anyone would think differently than him. He lowered almost 7% of our overall grades unfairly. He comes in late everyday and is very scattered. He never got grades in on time and was a poor discussion leader. I read none of the books and got an A as a freshman in his jr honors class....

Seriously, don't take him! This is my 4th year in college and he is, by far, the worst professor I've ever had. He is late every day and comes in to class looking disheveled and unprepared. On papers, he cannot explain why he gave you the grade he did. The only grades we have are 4 essays that he does not explain at all. No powerpoints or ecampus
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took his class twice: first time, I was not a fan.  He seemed absent minded and not a very strong discussion leader.  Took another class from him a year later.  SO MUCH BETTER!  I got the sense that he truly cared about his students and wanted to hear what we had to say.  He was very encouraging and gave specific feedback on my paper.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I loved his class so much. He is a good professor and is not very tough when grading papers but gives lots of comments and feedback. You cannot get through this class without reading the books. This class is easy as long as you do what is expected of you.

He is a really good professor with a great mind. If you don't take the time to read the books and listen to his lectures, you won't understand how to get the correct answer. He teaches upper level english, if you can't write at a JR-Sr level then yeah, you're going to have a problem. But the class is not hard AT ALL for those with any sort of sense

TERRIBLE GRADER!! He cannot justify why he gave you a specific grade. Talking to him doesn't help because he is incapable of understanding why or how people don't think EXACTLY like he does. I have never had so many issues with a professor before. The class as a whole was aggravated with his grading style because it was always so random. DON'T TAKE

He gives take home quizzes, an essay, and a take home final and grades incredibly hard. He doesn't explain why you received the grade that you received. The way he grades seems like a complete wild card. Would not recommend him.

There were about 6 or 7 reading assignments that were assigned in his class. The books were all pretty interesting, so that wasn't bad. There are 4 take home quizzes, a 4 page paper, and a take home final. His work was not stressful or too hard. You do have to work pretty hard to get an A. He doesn't force anyone to be involved in the discussion.

He is a really nice guy but his class is so boring. He assigns readings out of several books (not textbooks) and in class you basically re-read the same material with him. It makes it VERY boring. He gives 4 take home quizzes and a take home final. They are all essay. Overall, pretty easy. Just do the readings and you will be fine.
